newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Friday, issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said the rates continued to move in a narrow range in slow trading today, with falling short-term fund supply supporting the contracts.
"Some banks which used to be major lenders had fewer funds to offer today, which supported the rates," one trader said.
"The market has no fresh stimulus around the corner," said a second trader. "The rates are likely to stay at current levels in the coming days."
But traders said that, in the longer term, the rates were under downward pressure due to suffficient money supply at the national level. - Shanghai newsroom (86-21) 6279-7004
